title: Decide the Desktop app framework: Tauri vs Electron
body:
docs/OVERVIEW.md lists both Tauri and Electron as candidates for the Desktop presentation layer, but no ADR has been written yet. This should be resolved with a proper ADR before UI work starts, so it isn't decided implicitly by whichever example someone copies first.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- ADR written comparing Tauri and Electron for this project's constraints (bundle size, Python interop, team familiarity)
- Decision recorded and referenced by future Desktop app issues

title: Build the campaign viewer UI
body:
Implement the main Desktop dashboard view: browse campaigns, sessions, NPCs, quests and the timeline built by the Core.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Reads exclusively through Core's application/interfaces layer, never the database directly
- Displays at least sessions, NPCs and the timeline

title: Implement campaign search in the dashboard
body:
Expose the semantic search capability (see the AI epic) through the dashboard UI.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Natural-language search box wired to Core's search use case
- Results link back to the originating session/entity

title: Wire up export actions from the dashboard
body:
Let users trigger the Markdown/HTML/PDF/JSON exporters (see the Export epic) directly from the dashboard.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Dashboard calls Core's export use case, not the exporters directly
- User can choose the export format and destination
